instruction: Build a webhook ingestion service with Fastify following best practices
relevant_when: Agent builds a Fastify endpoint that receives webhooks or external event payloads
context: Proactively check that the agent applies Fastify best practices when building a webhook handler: strict JSON Schema validation on incoming payloads, plugin encapsulation for the webhook routes, structured error responses, and proper logging of received events.

checklist.name: strict-body-schema
checklist.rule: The webhook route defines a strict JSON Schema for the request body with required fields, type constraints, and additionalProperties: false to reject unexpected payloads
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates a Fastify route that receives webhook payloads

checklist.name: webhook-plugin-encapsulated
checklist.rule: Webhook routes are encapsulated in a Fastify plugin registered with app.register(), not defined on the root app
checklist.relevant_when: Agent structures webhook handling code in Fastify

checklist.name: structured-error-response
checklist.rule: Invalid webhook payloads receive a structured error response (not just a generic 400) with a code field and descriptive message so the sender can debug

checklist.name: event-logging
checklist.rule: Received webhook events are logged using request.log with structured context (event type, source, outcome) rather than console.log

checklist.name: idempotent-handling
checklist.rule: Agent considers idempotency for webhook processing -- checking for duplicate event IDs or using an idempotency key to prevent reprocessing
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a webhook handler that triggers side effects

checklist.name: error-handler-set
checklist.rule: A custom error handler (app.setErrorHandler) is configured to return structured error responses, with validation errors handled distinctly from server errors
checklist.relevant_when: Agent sets up a Fastify application for webhook ingestion
